title: TaleDocument
description: A tale document, version 1: the canvas and the elements of one tale. Each element's `props` are checked against the schema its `type` names in `element-types/registry.json`; an unknown type is refused on write and skipped by clients.

version.description: The document version. Additive changes keep it; a breaking change raises it and ships a forward migration.

durationMs.description: How long the tale shows, in milliseconds, when it has no video; 7000 when left out. With a video element the tale plays for the video's length.

elements.description: The elements, first at the bottom of the z-order.

MediaBackground.description: An image (GIF included) or a video (MP4 or WebM) filling the canvas, of the tale's project by its storage key, or by `externalUrl`: an https address on another site. It is decorative. `color` fills the bands `contain` leaves, and the canvas until the media shows. A video plays muted and loops.

mediaKey.description: The storage key of an image or video of the tale's project, as the server made it.

externalUrl.description: An https address of an image or video on another site, shown instead of a `mediaKey`. Its page's content security policy must allow it.

kind.description: `video` for a video, else an image. Left out, a `mediaKey` ending .mp4 or .webm is a video and anything else an image; an `externalUrl` is an image unless this says `video`.

Box.description: Where an element sits, as fractions (0 to 1) of the canvas width (x, w) and height (y, h), and its rotation in degrees about its centre.

A11y.description: What assistive technology is told about the element.

ElementType.description: A key of the element-type registry.

ElementId.description: A UUID, unique in the document.

Element.description: One element. `hidden` and `locked` are editor state and are never delivered.
